article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 80% Indica / 20% Sativa
Genetics: Bubble Gum backcross
Breeder: White Label Seed Company
THC Content: 17–19%
CBD Content: N/A
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Beta-Caryophyllene , Limonene
Primary Flavors: Pink Bubblegum, Strawberry Candy
Flowering Time (Indoor): 45–50 Days
Outdoor Harvest Time: September
Indoor Yield: Large
Outdoor Yield: Large
Grow Difficulty: Easy

Before cannabis dispensaries began filling their menus with elaborate dessert names, breeders were already searching for a particular kind of sweetness: the unmistakable fragrance of old-fashioned pink chewing gum. Double Gum emerged from that pursuit as a distinctive expression of the classic Bubble Gum family, emphasizing concentrated candy aromas without abandoning the physical strength of traditional indica marijuana. Developed by White Label Seed Company, the sister brand of Sensi Seeds , this award-winning hybrid combines compact growth, substantial flowering potential, and a deeply relaxing psychoactive character.

Its flowers carry an unusually sweet fragrance reminiscent of strawberry bubblegum, sugary berries, and soft fruit candy, accompanied by subtle earthy undertones. Unlike many contemporary hybrids built around complicated multi-generational crosses, this cultivar reflects an earlier breeding philosophy centered on refining recognizable characteristics through careful selection. Its first-place finish at the 2004 Highlife Cup helped establish its reputation, while its short flowering period and forgiving growth habits have kept it relevant among enthusiasts of classic European cannabis genetics.
Genetics and Lineage

Double Gum belongs to the original Bubble Gum genetic family, with its ancestry commonly described as a Bubble Gum backcross involving selected expressions of the same foundational variety. The breeding emphasizes the sweet aromatic characteristics that made Bubble Gum influential during the development of modern Dutch marijuana genetics. White Label Seed Company, an affiliated brand of Sensi Seeds, refined this genetic background into a predominantly indica hybrid containing approximately 80% indica and 20% sativa ancestry. Although the Bubble Gum connection is well established, the breeder has not publicly detailed every parental selection or the exact sequence of crosses. Consequently, the cultivar is best understood as a selectively developed Bubble Gum derivative rather than a cross with unrelated modern dessert strains .

The broader Bubble Gum family traces its history to American cannabis breeding during the 1980s, with Indiana frequently identified as its place of origin. Selected plants subsequently moved through breeding communities in New England before reaching the Netherlands, where Dutch breeders continued refining their aromatic characteristics and cultivation performance. This international development helped transform Bubble Gum from a regional American selection into one of the recognizable flavor-oriented cannabis families of the 1990s. Its ancestry reflects the hybridization practices of that era, when breeders combined indica and sativa characteristics while selecting for sweetness, resin production, and dependable flowering behavior.

The objective behind Double Gum was to intensify the familiar chewing-gum fragrance while maintaining a manageable plant structure. Through selection within the Bubble Gum family, White Label developed a hybrid with pronounced candy sweetness, substantial central flowers, and relatively limited flowering stretch. The genetic emphasis differs considerably from newer varieties that combine Cookies, Gelato, Z, or modern fruit-oriented genetics. Instead, this cultivar preserves an earlier expression of cannabis breeding, where stability, recognizable aroma, and consistent growth mattered more than extravagant lineage complexity.
Effects and Experience

Double Gum produces an experience rooted in traditional indica relaxation, although the opening sensations can be more cheerful than its genetic classification suggests. A gentle wave of euphoria may develop first, introducing an enjoyable sense of contentment and slightly heightened appreciation for sensory experiences. Music, familiar conversations, and leisurely entertainment can feel more absorbing as the initial effects become established. Rather than creating a forceful rush of cerebral stimulation, the experience generally favors a comfortable mental atmosphere with a dreamy quality. This modest psychological uplift provides an interesting contrast to the more substantial physical relaxation that follows.

As intoxication progresses, the body begins to feel noticeably heavier. Muscular tension may seem less prominent, while the desire for demanding activities gradually diminishes. The experience can develop into a distinctly stoned sensation associated with classic indica cannabis, encouraging quiet recreation, comfortable seating, and unhurried evenings. Higher doses may introduce stronger drowsiness and make sustained concentration more difficult. The breeder emphasizes the cultivar’s substantial body-centered effects, although individual responses depend on cannabinoid concentration, consumption method, and personal tolerance. Some consumers may remain conversational and mentally engaged at moderate exposure, while others experience considerably greater physical heaviness.

Potency should not be underestimated simply because the strain predates the modern pursuit of exceptionally high THC percentages. Third-party descriptions commonly place its THC concentration around 17–19%, although these figures are not a standardized breeder-certified average. Individual harvests may differ significantly. Excessive consumption can cause dizziness, anxiety, dry mouth, dry eyes, impaired coordination, or temporary memory difficulties. The cultivar’s relaxing character also makes it less appropriate for activities requiring sustained alertness. As with other intoxicating marijuana products, driving or operating machinery while impaired should be avoided.
Medical Benefits

The substantial physical relaxation associated with Double Gum may interest medical marijuana patients seeking temporary relief from certain symptoms. Some THC-containing cannabis products have demonstrated modest benefits for particular types of chronic pain, especially neuropathic discomfort. The cultivar’s body-centered effects may appeal to individuals whose discomfort becomes more noticeable during evening rest or after physically demanding activities. Its relatively calm mental character could also make the experience subjectively more comfortable for some patients. However, controlled clinical studies evaluating this specific strain have not been published, and its ancestry cannot establish effectiveness for pain, inflammation, or muscle-related conditions.

Stress-related complaints represent another possible area of interest. The gentle euphoria may temporarily improve subjective mood, while the later physical heaviness could help some individuals unwind after demanding days. Consumers who experience difficulty settling down at night may find the relaxing character compatible with their preferred evening routine. Nevertheless, sedation does not necessarily indicate improved sleep quality. Evidence concerning cannabis as a long-term treatment for insomnia remains inconsistent, and repeated THC exposure can produce tolerance, dependence, or changes in normal sleep patterns. High-potency weed may also aggravate anxiety or panic in susceptible individuals.

Medical suitability depends on laboratory-tested cannabinoid concentrations, personal health history, existing medications, and previous cannabis experience. THC can impair attention, influence cardiovascular responses, and interact with certain prescription medications, including sedatives. Patients considering this cultivar for symptom management should consult a qualified healthcare professional rather than assuming that a traditional indica classification guarantees therapeutic benefits. Double Gum may provide subjective comfort for some individuals, but its effectiveness has not been established as a treatment for any specific medical condition.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

The defining sensory characteristic of Double Gum is its remarkably concentrated chewing-gum sweetness. Properly developed flowers release an aroma closely resembling classic pink bubblegum, complete with sugary strawberry impressions and a soft mixture of ripe fruit. Unlike modern candy-oriented cannabis varieties that frequently incorporate sharp citrus, diesel, or artificial-candy characteristics, this cultivar emphasizes a rounded, nostalgic sweetness. The fragrance can suggest strawberry gum freshly removed from its wrapper, accompanied by delicate berry syrup and a restrained herbal background. During flowering, this sugary character becomes increasingly noticeable as the resinous buds mature.

Breaking apart the dried flowers intensifies the fruit notes while revealing a slightly earthier foundation. The aroma may include subtle impressions of blueberries, sweet apples, and mild citrus, although the dominant characteristic remains unmistakably bubblegum-like. During consumption, the opening flavor generally emphasizes sugary strawberry candy before developing into softer mixed-fruit sweetness. A delicate earthy or herbal quality emerges toward the finish, giving the flavor enough contrast to avoid becoming excessively one-dimensional. Proper drying and curing help preserve the fragrance, while excessive heat and prolonged oxygen exposure can diminish the delicate volatile compounds responsible for its most recognizable characteristics.

A complete laboratory-confirmed terpene profile has not been established for White Label’s original release. Myrcene is a possible contributor to softer fruit and herbal impressions, while beta-caryophyllene could influence subtle woody or spicy qualities. Limonene may contribute to occasional citrus notes, although these associations remain hypothetical without testing of the specific flowers. The recognizable bubblegum fragrance may also involve additional volatile organic compounds that influence cannabis aroma at relatively low concentrations. Consequently, the cultivar’s distinctive sweetness cannot be attributed confidently to a single dominant terpene. Its aromatic identity reflects the combined expression of numerous compounds shaped by genetics, cultivation conditions, and post-harvest handling.
Growing Information

Double Gum develops into a compact cannabis plant with a pronounced central stem, closely spaced internodes, and relatively modest lateral branching. Its growth pattern reflects the influence of predominantly indica genetics, allowing the plant to maintain manageable dimensions throughout vegetative development and flowering . The central cola typically becomes the most prominent feature, developing into a substantial cluster of tightly arranged flowers. Smaller secondary branches support additional buds, although certain phenotypes produce more extensive lateral growth than others. White Label identifies these more heavily branched individuals as particularly interesting for maintaining mother plants and producing clones. The regular seed format allows growers to identify male and female specimens for breeding or selection purposes.

One of the cultivar’s principal advantages is its remarkably short flowering period. Indoor maturation generally requires approximately 45–50 days after flowering begins, placing the strain among the faster-finishing selections within the classic indica category. Vertical stretch during this period is usually limited, making the plant particularly suitable for indoor environments with restricted overhead space. White Label describes the variety as capable of producing large yields without unusually intensive cultivation requirements, although standardized gram-per-square-meter figures have not been published. Flower development concentrates heavily around the main cola, and well-established plants can produce substantial harvests relative to their compact dimensions.

The plant is particularly compatible with Sea of Green cultivation because of its short stature and prominent central flowering structure. More extensively branched phenotypes may also respond to careful canopy management, although elaborate training is not essential to achieving productive flowering. Outdoor cultivation is possible in temperate and continental regions with sufficiently warm summers, while greenhouse environments can provide additional protection from unpredictable weather. Early autumn harvests are possible in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates, although actual timing depends on latitude and seasonal conditions. Dense flowers require adequate airflow because moisture accumulation can encourage fungal problems during the final weeks of maturation. Its relatively forgiving growth characteristics make Double Gum accessible to beginners, while the regular seed format and potential for selecting productive mother plants offer additional appeal to experienced cannabis cultivators.
FAQ
Is Double Gum an indica or sativa strain?

Double Gum is an indica-dominant hybrid containing approximately 80% indica and 20% sativa genetics. Developed by White Label Seed Company, the cultivar belongs to the classic Bubble Gum family. Its experience emphasizes physical relaxation accompanied by a gentle sense of euphoria, while its compact growth structure and short flowering period reflect its predominantly indica heritage.
What is the THC percentage of Double Gum?

THC concentrations are commonly reported around 17–19%, although the breeder has not established a universal laboratory-confirmed percentage. Actual cannabinoid levels can vary between individual plants, cultivation environments, and harvests. Laboratory testing of the specific cannabis product provides the most reliable information about strength.
What does Double Gum taste like?

The flavor resembles classic pink bubblegum, with concentrated strawberry candy, sweet mixed berries, and subtle fruity undertones. Softer impressions of apple, blueberry, and mild citrus may also appear. The dominant character remains sugary and confectionery, supported by a restrained earthy or herbal finish that distinguishes it from more aggressively pungent marijuana varieties.
Does Double Gum make you sleepy?

The cultivar can produce substantial drowsiness, particularly during the later stages of intoxication or after larger doses. Its initial effects may include gentle euphoria and improved mood, but progressive physical relaxation generally becomes the dominant sensation. Individual responses depend on cannabinoid concentration, dosage, and THC tolerance.
How long does Double Gum take to flower?

Indoor flowering generally requires approximately 45–50 days, making this a relatively fast-maturing photoperiod cannabis variety. White Label describes large yield potential, compact growth, and limited vertical stretch during flowering. Outdoor harvests may occur in early autumn in suitable climates. The original release is available as regular seeds, which can produce both male and female plants.
Final Thoughts on Double Gum

Double Gum represents a distinctive period in cannabis breeding when recognizable flavor, reliable cultivation, and genetic refinement were central priorities. By intensifying the sweetness associated with the original Bubble Gum family, White Label Seed Company created a weed strain whose pink chewing-gum fragrance remains its defining characteristic. The combination of concentrated strawberry-candy aromas, compact flowers, and substantial physical relaxation provides a recognizable expression of traditional indica-oriented marijuana.

For consumers, the experience offers gentle mental euphoria followed by a deeper, more restful physical sensation. Growers benefit from vigorous development, manageable plant dimensions, a short flowering period, and substantial harvest potential without unusually complicated cultivation requirements. Its regular seed format also makes the cultivar relevant to breeders interested in preserving and selecting classic cannabis genetics.

With its first-place recognition at the 2004 Highlife Cup and its enduring connection to the original Bubble Gum family, Double Gum occupies a noteworthy position in European marijuana breeding history. It demonstrates that memorable cannabis does not always require complicated modern genetics. Sometimes a carefully refined classic, supported by dependable growth and an unmistakable flavor, is enough to establish a lasting identity.
